sections.appearance: She has long shoulder-length strawberry blonde hair with bangs and tied into several pigtails using blue ribbons. She has also lime eyes. Halo ==== Midori's halo consists of two neon green circles with four pointed kites on its rim directed inwards. Her halo is an exact copy of Momoi's, but with a neon green color instead. Uniform ==== She wears a standard Millennium high-school uniform, including a white and green hoodie, an untucked white shirt with a blue tie underneath and white accented black shorts, alongside a long pair of socks and black boots with green edges. She also wears a cat-eared headset with a neon green color scheme. Winter version: She was wearing a white and light blue hooded jacket with black trim, two zippers on each sleeve, and the Game Development Department logo. She also wore a white scarf and light green gloves, light gray tights, and dark gray boots with white fur lining for warmth. She has a black tail with two green stripes at the end. Firearm ==== thumb|Flashy Inspiration|150px She uses a green H&K G3SG/1 designated marksman rifle with a crystal in place of the muzzle brake. A red cat-like critter strap hangs on the trigger guard. A Game Development Department decal is stickered on the stock.

sections.personality: Contrasting Momoi, Midori is quieter and more reserved, only giving in to outbursts when angered or excited. She is no less passionate towards gaming than her sister however, though she's less likely to be offended. She's also a bit more pessimistic than she is. When it comes to their feelings towards Sensei, Midori is the more overtly romantic of the two, although both sisters insist on hiding any possible romantic interactions from anyone else, especially the other sister.
